name: Poppy the Potter
description: Keeps the village wheel turning and always has a fresh pot in hand.

name: Biscuit the Dog
description: A friendly meadow dog who guards the kiln and fetches stray tiles.

name: Puddle the Duck
description: Paddles along the creek and quacks when a block slides home.

name: Scruff the Scarecrow
description: Keeps watch over the sunflowers, with a crow friend on one arm.

name: Marmalade the Cat
description: A market-square cat who naps on warm cobbles and watches every move.

name: Old Ember the Kiln Master
description: Sooty, proud and patient, he has fired every glaze at the Great Kiln.

name: Mabel the Stallholder
description: Sells apples and chatter from a striped stall in Market Town.

name: Gumnut the Koala
description: Dozes on a gum branch and wakes only for a very good puzzle.

name: Captain Brine
description: Runs the ferry off Seaside Pier and keeps a lifebuoy handy.

name: Flurry the Snow-goat
description: A scarfed mountain goat who hops the icy ledges of Snowy Peaks.

name: Wick the Lantern Keeper
description: Lights every lantern in the garden at dusk, one pole at a time.

name: Dune the Camel Trader
description: Hauls glass and bright rugs across the desert with a patient smile.
